citations.claim: energy grew with no controller work and exceeds E0+10%+5J at first violating step
speed increased from 60 to 63.76 despite e=1 and no energy input

explanation: Single body with e=1 bouncing under gravity gains energy with zero controller work. Semi-implicit Euler falling under gravity plus elastic bounce with positional correction injects net energy each floor impact (vy magnitude grows), so total mechanical energy drifts above E0+10%+5J by step 11.
vision_note: The blue dot moves steadily left at mid-height through steps 8 to 10, then jumps to a much lower position near the bottom in step 11. It stays blue in all tiles with no walls, waypoints, bounce, or red violation highlighting visible.
